decision.review: Stop this continuation at the first external gate: web CE regressed 4.48911564424634 to 4.978963398374617; paired context accuracy fell 1/32 to 0/32. All 32 new raw completions reviewed: repeated phrases, unsupported causal explanations, entity drift and synthetic textbook/story style remain prominent. Source validation improved but does not demonstrate transfer. No usable conversation or tool-call model demonstrated; no promotion, private acceptance or parameter scaling justified. Preserve parent and current checkpoint. Diagnose mixture/domain forgetting and design a separately frozen broad-language replay intervention before further training; do not resume this mixture unchanged.

interpretation: Consistent with domain specialization/forgetting; this is a hypothesis, not an isolated causal finding. More of this unchanged mixture is not justified.
next_work: Audit original broad-language TRAIN custody and replay availability without touching held-out/private data.
Design a bounded broad-language-dominant continuation with fixed transfer gates and preserved budgets/STOP safeguards.
Keep 124M architecture and defer SFT/scaling until transfer evidence supports them.
